title: Timeline editor
idea: Timeline editor: Tracks align to a time ruler with an independent preview
audience: People who need to edit sequence within a desktop surface.
avoidWhen: A static list adequately expresses the task
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic timeline layout through its edit sequence priority and explicit commitment contract: Destructive trim supports undo and clear duration changes
navigation: Timeline editor keeps the current edit sequence context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Tracks align to a time ruler with an independent preview
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to edit sequence; temporal relationships matter
composition.priority: Destructive trim supports undo and clear duration changes

imagery.role: Support the actual edit sequence context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Preserve horizontal timeline scrolling and keyboard selection
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the timeline editor structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no edit sequence content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Destructive trim supports undo and clear duration changes
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized edit sequence content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Destructive trim supports undo and clear duration changes
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active edit sequence context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
